description.content: Beta Version: 10.10.0.cl or later Creates a customization configuration for the notification email. #### Pre-requisites Requires `DEVELOPER` (**has developer privilege**) or `ADMINISTRATION` (**Can administer ThoughtSpot**) privilege. If [Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)](https://developers.thoughtspot.com/docs/rbac) is enabled on your instance, the `DEVELOPER` (**Has developer privilege**) privilege is required. **NOTE**:This endpoint in currently in beta. Contact ThoughtSpot support to enable this on your instance. #### Usage guidelines To create a custom configuration pass these parameters in your API request: - A JSON map of configuration attributes `template_properties`.
